biography.value:
Description

A black mushroom with a fanged mouth and a varying number of eyes. Death caps smell of death and decay and are a living nightmare when it comes to status affects.

Defense

AC 22, touch 15, flat-footed 17 (+5 dex, +7 natural)

HP 136 [182] (13d8+78)

Fort +13, Reflex +11, Will +7

Immune plant traits; Resist Earth 10, Ice 10, Dark 10

Weakness Fire

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee Bite +14 (1d10+3 plus poison), 2 Slams +12 (1d6+1 plus poison)

Special Attacks Bad Breath, Dream Pollen, Poison Gas

Statistics

Str 16, Dex 20, Con 20, Int 7, Wis 16, Cha 20

Base Atk +9; CMB +12; CMD 27

Feats Blind-Fight, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Finesse

Skills Stealth +19 (+23 in swamps and underground), Survival +4 (+8 in swamps and underground), Perception +4; Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth and Survival in swamps and underground

description.value: Slam and Bite - injury; save Fort DC 21; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect poisoned and fatigue; cure 1 save

target.value: creature hit by Slam or Bite

effect: Injury; poison and fatigue. Once per round for six rounds; one save cures.
Resolve Poison after a successful Slam or Bite attack.

description.value: 3/day, a death cap can emit a 30-ft.-cone of foul gas. All creatures caught within the cone are affected by the following status effects for 1d4 rounds each: Berserk (Will save DC 21 to negate), Blind (Fortitude save DC 21 to negate), Confuse (Will save DC 21 to negate), Silence (Fortitude save DC 21 to negate), Poison (Fortitude save DC 21 to resist), Slow (Fortitude save DC 21 to negate). The death cap must wait 1d4 rounds to use this ability again. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 25).

effect: One breath, six independent saves; failed Berserk lasts 1d4 rounds. Deduct once for the entire cone.
Wait [[1d4]] rounds between uses; daily charges do not refresh.
One breath, six independent saves; failed Blind lasts 1d4 rounds. Deduct once for the entire cone.
One breath, six independent saves; failed Confuse lasts 1d4 rounds. Deduct once for the entire cone.
One breath, six independent saves; failed Silence lasts 1d4 rounds. Deduct once for the entire cone.
One breath, six independent saves; failed Poison lasts 1d4 rounds. Deduct once for the entire cone.
One breath, six independent saves; failed Slow lasts 1d4 rounds. Deduct once for the entire cone.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 25).

description.value: 3/day, a death cap can fill the air with drowsiness within a 15-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect must make a Will save (DC 21) or be inflicted with sleep status for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 19).

effect: Failed save: give the target Dream Pollen: sleep (recipient). Activate on the recipient, not the caster.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 19).

description.value: 3/day, a death cap can release a poison gas from itself spread outward in a 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 12d6 points of non-elemental damage and are inflicted with Poison status for 1d6 rounds, a successful Fortitude save (DC 21) to negate the status effect and reduce the damage by half. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 27).

effect: Half damage and no Poison on save. Poison lasts 1d6 rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 27).

description.value: A death cap constantly emits a putrid stench that nearly every form of animal life finds offensive. All living creatures (except death caps or other funguar) within 30 feet of a death cap must succeed on a DC 21 Fortitude save or be nauseated for as long as they remain within 30 feet of the creature. Moving out of the affected area leaves the character sickened for 1 round after which time he recovers immediately. The save DC is Constitution-based. Creatures that successfully save cannot be affected by the same death cap's stench for 24 hours. This is a poison effect.

effect: Living non-funguar: nauseated inside, sickened one round after leaving. Success grants immunity to this individual's stench for 24h.
Failed save: give the target Stench: nauseated (recipient). Activate on the recipient, not the caster.
On exit, replace Stench: nauseated (recipient) with Stench: left the area for one round.
